Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Many, many thanks for prompt [payment](/topic/160), an agreeable sight on a winter’s morning I think [the story](/book/131) in the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52)will finish there about next spring It is not longer than the [Three Brides](/book/120), but has been in short chapters. I have not finished writing it yet, but the beginning may be printed when it is convenient. I am correcting the [Moors and Christians](/book/126) gradually, and will send the result soon I see one or two little corrections are wanting in the [Primer](/book/353). When shall I send them

Yours truly

C M Yonge
